exact_prompt:
I'm shopping for cottage cheese in the United States.

I want cottage cheese with live and active cultures. Which brand should I choose, and why?
reviewed_answer:
Choose Good Culture—specifically its Simply 2% Low-Fat Classic or Classic 4% Whole Milk cottage cheese. It is widely available in U.S. grocery stores, explicitly contains live and active cultures, and has a short ingredient list centered on milk, cream, sea salt, and cultures rather than gums or thickeners.

Why Good Culture

Live and active cultures: Its cottage cheese is made with live probiotic cultures, which is the feature you specifically want.

Simple formulation: Reviews note it avoids gums, thickeners, and stabilizers; the ingredient list is essentially organic milk, cream, sea salt, and cultures.

Good taste and texture: Wirecutter’s 2026 testing named Good Culture’s Simply 2% its top pick, praising its creamy texture, plush curds, and tang from the live cultures.

Choice of fat level: Pick 2% for a lower-fat option or 4% whole-milk for a richer, more traditional cottage cheese.

Strong alternatives
Brand	Why choose it
Nancy’s Organic Probiotic	Made with live active cultures and additional probiotic cultures; notably tangy, yogurt-like flavor. 

Daisy	Uses live and active cultures with only milk, cream, and salt; a good widely available, no-additive choice. 

Kalona SuperNatural Organic	Organic ingredients plus live and active cultures, available in 2% and 4% milkfat versions. 

Breakstone’s Live Active	A mainstream option specifically labeled with live active cultures. 
What to check on the label

Because cultures are not required to make cottage cheese, look for the exact phrase “live and active cultures” or “probiotic cultures” on the package—not merely “cultured milk.” Consumer Reports specifically recommends checking labels for this distinction.

If you want the best overall combination of confirmed live cultures, clean ingredients, and taste, buy Good Culture Simply 2% Low-Fat Classic Cottage Cheese; if you want the most pronounced probiotic/tangy profile, choose Nancy’s Organic Probiotic Cottage Cheese.
